purpose: Exact fixed focused question templates; add only current component facts per recorded schema. Experimental22m variant, not public15m CLI default.

instructions.rules:
DRIVING POLICY. Choose the next native input by executing the supplied policy exactly. Apply the following fixed bearing policy to the CURRENT factual state; its eligible wheel and pedal form one native input. These are supplied engineering rules, not a claim that the input is optimal or pursuit-equivalent. Read x=ego_x_m and y=ego_y_m from the wheel_facts.road.preview row whose ahead_m equals 22, using wheel_facts.road.preview_columns. The 22 m centre bearing theta equals round(degrees(atan2(y,x)),4), calculated from those rounded raw coordinates. If wheel_facts.road.preview_22m_bearing_deg is present, read theta directly from that factual scalar; otherwise compute theta yourself. Positive theta means LEFT of the CURRENT ACTUAL steering-direction axis, negative theta means RIGHT. Thresholds are -30, -7, +7 and +30 degrees; exact threshold ties choose the smaller absolute wheel angle. 
WHEEL TASK: Select the single allowed absolute wheel ID whose supplied policy condition holds. Return only that wheel choice.

criteria.hard_right: Hold wheels RIGHT at 6.88 degrees; a nominal bicycle turn radius of 14.9 metres before grip/response transients. FIXED POLICY ELIGIBILITY: choose this wheel exactly when theta < -30.
criteria.right: Hold wheels RIGHT at 3.44 degrees; a nominal bicycle turn radius of 30.0 metres before grip/response transients. FIXED POLICY ELIGIBILITY: choose this wheel exactly when -30 <= theta < -7.
criteria.straight: Hold wheels STRAIGHT at 0.00 degrees; a straight nominal path before grip/response transients. FIXED POLICY ELIGIBILITY: choose this wheel exactly when -7 <= theta <= +7.
criteria.left: Hold wheels LEFT at 3.44 degrees; a nominal bicycle turn radius of 30.0 metres before grip/response transients. FIXED POLICY ELIGIBILITY: choose this wheel exactly when +7 < theta <= +30.
criteria.hard_left: Hold wheels LEFT at 6.88 degrees; a nominal bicycle turn radius of 14.9 metres before grip/response transients. FIXED POLICY ELIGIBILITY: choose this wheel exactly when theta > +30.

instructions.rules:
PEDAL FIELD CHECK: the 3 metre threshold applies to left_edge_clearance_m or right_edge_clearance_m, not the magnitude of offset_m. Offset selects the side. When on_road is true and BOTH edge clearances are greater than 3 metres, B=false regardless of outward velocity, so this fixed policy selects accelerate. DRIVING POLICY. Choose the next native input by executing the supplied policy exactly. Apply the following fixed bearing policy to the CURRENT factual state; its eligible wheel and pedal form one native input. These are supplied engineering rules, not a claim that the input is optimal or pursuit-equivalent. Let speed=pedal_facts.kart.speed_m_s and L=pedal_facts.current_road_frame.velocity_left_m_s. Let B be true exactly when pedal_facts.road.on_road is false, OR (pedal_facts.road.offset_m>0 AND pedal_facts.road.left_edge_clearance_m<=3 AND L>=0.5), OR (pedal_facts.road.offset_m<0 AND pedal_facts.road.right_edge_clearance_m<=3 AND L<=-0.5). Otherwise B is false. The speed<2 acceleration rule takes priority even when B is true.
FIXED WORKED PEDAL EXAMPLES (speed and L in m/s, distances in metres; never the current query's answer): on_road=true, offset_m=-10, left_edge_clearance_m=22, right_edge_clearance_m=2, L=+1, speed=8: right-side clearance is small but velocity is inward; B=false -> accelerate. on_road=true, offset_m=+10, left_edge_clearance_m=2, right_edge_clearance_m=22, L=-1, speed=8: left-side clearance is small but velocity is inward; B=false -> accelerate. on_road=true, offset_m=-10, left_edge_clearance_m=22, right_edge_clearance_m=2, L=-1, speed=8: all three right-side predicates hold; B=true -> brake. on_road=true, offset_m=+10, left_edge_clearance_m=2, right_edge_clearance_m=22, L=+1, speed=8: all three left-side predicates hold; B=true -> brake. on_road=false, speed=0: low-speed priority -> accelerate. on_road=false, speed=4: B=true -> coast. on_road=false, speed=8: B=true -> brake.
PEDAL TASK: Select the single allowed pedal ID whose supplied policy condition holds. Return only that pedal choice; the wheel is selected separately in this same request.
FIXED PEDAL CONTRASTS, never current answers: speed=12,on_road=true,offset_m=+4,left_edge_clearance_m=8,right_edge_clearance_m=16,L=+2 -> B=false -> accelerate; offset_m=+10,left_edge_clearance_m=2,right_edge_clearance_m=22,L=+2 -> B=true -> brake. Mirrors: offset_m=-4,left_edge_clearance_m=16,right_edge_clearance_m=8,L=-2 -> B=false -> accelerate; offset_m=-10,left_edge_clearance_m=22,right_edge_clearance_m=2,L=-2 -> B=true -> brake, at the same speed12/on_road=true.

criteria.accelerate: ACCELERATE: throttle 1, brake 0. FIXED POLICY ELIGIBILITY: choose ACCELERATE exactly when speed<2 OR (speed>=2 AND B is false).
criteria.coast: COAST: throttle 0, brake 0. FIXED POLICY ELIGIBILITY: choose COAST exactly when B is true AND 2<=speed<=6.
criteria.brake: BRAKE: throttle 0, brake 1. FIXED POLICY ELIGIBILITY: choose BRAKE exactly when B is true AND speed>6.

current_geometry_projection.source: 22m lookahead row in raw_current.track.lookahead; current ACTUAL kart.steering_angle
current_geometry_projection.source_rounding: raw x,y3decimals; raw actual steering_angle5decimals from observation
current_geometry_projection.units: CURRENT metres/degrees, positive LEFT, axis aligned with heading plus actual steering angle; not a future pose or desired wheel
current_geometry_projection.domain: Existing15m forward/gate domain and selected22m bodyx>0; exit before another model POST on domain failure
current_geometry_projection.pedal_projection: Keep current rule quantities. Remove unused next_gate from pedal view; compact applicable units. Do not compute B or a per-query answer.

response_contract: Original factored native wheel+pedal choices in one POST, original DecisionClient.decide and inverse. Strict complete native outputs, no host correction.
